items.title_en: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
items.title_zh: 琳賽·克蘭西因涉嫌殺害三名子女將於 2027 年春季面臨新審判
items.summary_en: A court in Massachusetts set a new trial for Lindsay Clancy in 2027. Prosecutors want to convict her for the death of her three young children.
items.summary_zh: 麻薩諸塞州法院已將琳賽·克蘭西的新審判安排在 2027 年。檢察官正尋求將她定罪，指控她殺害三名年幼子女。
items.why_important_en: This case shows how the legal system deals with tragic family crimes and mental health questions.
items.why_important_zh: 此案展現了法律體系如何處理悲劇性的家庭犯罪與心理健康問題。

vocab.definition_en: a formal meeting in a court to decide if someone is guilty of a crime
vocab.sentence_en: You can sign up for a free thirty-day trial on their website.
vocab.sentence_zh: 你可以在他們的網站上註冊三十天的免費試用。

vocab.definition_en: to try to find or get something
vocab.sentence_en: Our company is seeking an experienced manager for the sales team.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們公司正在為業務團隊尋找一位有經驗的主管。

vocab.definition_en: an official decision in court that someone is guilty of a crime
vocab.sentence_en: She answered every interview question with strong confidence and conviction.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她帶著堅定的自信與信念回答了每一個面試問題。

items.title_en: Gérard Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction
items.title_zh: 傑哈·德巴狄厄放棄對性侵定罪的判決上訴
items.summary_en: French actor Gérard Depardieu decided to stop his appeal against a court conviction. He accepted the guilty verdict and said he is deeply sorry to the two victims.
items.summary_zh: 法國演員傑哈·德巴狄厄決定放棄對法院定罪判決的上訴。他接受了有罪判決，並表示對兩名受害者深感抱歉。
items.why_important_en: It shows that high-profile celebrities are being held accountable for past misconduct.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示知名公眾人物正在為過去的不當行為承擔責任。

vocab.definition_en: a formal request to a higher court to change a legal decision
vocab.sentence_en: The modern design of this smartphone has a wide appeal to young people.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這款智慧型手機的現代設計對年輕人很有吸引力。

vocab.definition_en: to say sorry for doing something wrong
vocab.sentence_en: I must apologize for arriving late to our morning meeting.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我很抱歉早上的會議遲到了。

vocab.definition_en: to agree to take something or admit that something is true
vocab.sentence_en: Does this coffee shop accept credit cards or mobile payments?
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家咖啡店接受信用卡或行動支付嗎？

vocab.definition_en: honest and saying what you really feel
vocab.sentence_en: Thank you for your sincere help during my first week at work.
vocab.sentence_zh: 謝謝你在我上班第一週給予的真誠協助。

items.title_en: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
items.title_zh: 五個歐盟國家宣布在盧安達設立移民遣返中心
items.summary_en: Five European nations announced a new centre in Rwanda. They plan to send failed asylum seekers there.
items.summary_zh: 五個歐洲國家宣布在盧安達設立一個新中心。他們計劃將申請庇護失敗的人送往那裡。
items.why_important_en: European countries are testing new ways outside Europe to manage immigration problems.
items.why_important_zh: 歐洲國家正在嘗試在歐洲境外處理移民問題的新方式。

vocab.sentence_en: The airline will announce our departure gate in a few minutes.
vocab.sentence_zh: 航空公司會在幾分鐘內公布我們的登機門。

vocab.definition_en: the central and most active part of a place or system
vocab.sentence_en: This busy airport serves as a major hub for international flights.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這座繁忙的機場是國際航班的重要樞紐。

vocab.definition_en: to not succeed in doing something
vocab.sentence_en: Please call this number if you fail to open the electronic lock.
vocab.sentence_zh: 如果您無法打開電子鎖，請撥打此號碼。

items.title_en: Five EU states announce plans for immigration ‘return hubs’ in Rwanda
items.title_zh: 五個歐盟成員國宣布在盧安達設立移民「遣返樞紐」計畫
items.summary_en: Five EU nations plan to build an offshore center in Rwanda for people without legal rights to stay. This plan uses a new EU law, but critics call it morally wrong.
items.summary_zh: 五個歐盟國家計劃在盧安達建立境外中心，安置無合法居留權的人。該計畫利用了歐盟新法規，但批評者認為這在道德上有嚴重瑕疵。
items.why_important_en: This policy could change how European nations enforce immigration rules and handle legal appeals.
items.why_important_zh: 該政策可能會改變歐洲各國執行移民規定及處理法律上訴的方式。

vocab.definition_en: something difficult that tests your ability and skill
vocab.sentence_en: Moving to a foreign city for work can be an exciting challenge.
vocab.sentence_zh: 為了工作搬到國外城市可能是一個令人興奮的挑戰。

vocab.definition_en: allowed by the law or relating to the law
vocab.sentence_en: You should get some professional legal advice before signing this rental contract.
vocab.sentence_zh: 在簽訂這份租賃合約之前，你應該先取得專業的法律諮詢。

vocab.definition_en: to use up completely, such as supplies or options
vocab.sentence_en: We have exhausted all our options to find a cheap hotel room.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們已經用盡所有尋找平價飯店房間的辦法了。

vocab.definition_en: to express disapproval of someone or something
vocab.sentence_en: It is not polite to criticize your coworker's taste in clothing.
vocab.sentence_zh: 批評同事的穿衣品味是不禮貌的。

items.title_en: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
items.title_zh: 加州因駭客攻擊風險起訴 OpenAI
items.summary_en: California is suing OpenAI over poor security. Officials say the company should have easily predicted the recent cyberattack.
items.summary_zh: 加州政府因資安防護不足起訴 OpenAI。官員表示，該公司本應能夠輕易預見近期的網路攻擊。
items.why_important_en: Governments are taking stronger legal actions to make tech companies protect user data and cybersecurity.
items.why_important_zh: 政府正採取更強硬的法律行動，迫使科技公司保護用戶資料與網路安全。

vocab.definition_en: to make a legal claim against someone in court
vocab.sentence_en: The customer threatened to sue the store after slipping on the wet floor.
vocab.sentence_zh: 顧客在濕滑的地板上滑倒後威脅要起訴這家店。

vocab.definition_en: to examine a problem or crime carefully to discover the truth
vocab.sentence_en: The manager promised to investigate the customer complaint right away.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理承諾會立即調查這起客戶投訴。

vocab.definition_en: protection against danger, loss, or crime
vocab.sentence_en: Please show your employee ID badge to the security guard at the door.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請向門口的警衛出示您的員工識別證。

vocab.definition_en: the usual way of doing something in a business or situation
vocab.sentence_en: Sending a thank-you email after an interview is standard business practice.
vocab.sentence_zh: 面試後發送感謝信是標準的商務慣例。
